title: Technical report
blurb: One report for the whole programme.
steps: Open the technical report writing guidelines in the SIWES course materials.
Write one report that covers your whole SIWES experience.
Upload it with your signed logbook after SIWES II.
Prepare slides for your defence with the key points.

facts.t: You submit the report once, at the end of SIWES II. No separate 3-month report.
Trained at two organisations? One combined report is enough, and the slides should cover both.
Your grade depends on the report following the guidelines.

faqs.q: Do I submit a report for each 3 months?
faqs.a: You are expected to only submit your technical report at the end of your SIWES II along with your filled logbook

faqs.q: I trained at two organisations. Do I write two reports?
faqs.a: Since you would be defending both SIWES programs together, making a single report including both experiences should suffice. This also applies for the presentation slides, they should include key information about both trainings

faqs.q: I finished SIWES. What do I submit?
faqs.a: If you have completed your SIWES I & II, and have undergone supervision, you are expected to submit your duly signed and filled logbook, and a technical report covering your experience through the LMS. After which you are supposed to reach out to your course coordinator for your defense
